MIST_FREE.Title: Free actions
MIST_FREE.Hint: Every downtime roll (a learn project, spell study, recipe research, brewing) spends one free action. At 0 the roll still goes ahead, without spending.
MIST_FREE.CounterPlayer: Free actions left for downtime: each project, study or brewing roll spends one
MIST_FREE.SpentFor: {actor} spends a free action on {reason} ({left} left).
